profile.name: Hoang Kim
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Kim. I am a Frontend Developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript and TailwindCSS. I have experience building scalable web applications and working with real world systems across different domains. Currently, I work as a developer at Mai Tech and also take on freelance projects, developing and maintaining modern web applications.

experienceItems.description: Designed and developed internal web applications, backend services, and automation workflows. Worked on healthcare related features for Ngoc Minh Clinic, including automated report generation, and recently built finance and trading support tools such as Bitcoin price tracking dashboards and condition based notification systems.

Developed education management systems for English centers such as TalkFirst and IELTS City. Built admin platforms for managing center operations, course payments, students, teachers, and class schedules, as well as student and teacher portals for schedules, attendance, classroom evaluation, and LMS learning activity workflows.

projectItems.title: Mai Talk
projectItems.description: An English speaking practice platform that allows users to record speaking answers and receive AI based scoring and feedback. Built fullstack features across user facing pages, backend logic, database workflows, API integration, English speaking practice, AI scoring, and user progress tracking.

projectItems.title: Ngoc Minh Healthcare Project
projectItems.description: A healthcare support tool that converts patient information files, X ray images, and related medical documents into PDF files for easier display on the user interface. Built a NodeJS based file processing tool and supported processed file preparation for more efficient UI display.

projectItems.title: Smart Campus System for TalkFirst and IELTS City
projectItems.description: A management system built for two English centers, TalkFirst and IELTS City, covering admin, teacher, and student portals for daily academic and operational workflows. Built frontend interfaces and backend APIs for student management, class scheduling, attendance tracking, weekly student QC, course registration, study progress tracking, staff operations, and academic operation management across multiple user roles. Technology: NextJS, NestJS, TailwindCSS, Material UI. Team: 3 members. The link below showcases the Student Portal interface, which is one part of the broader SmartCampus system.

projectItems.title: LMS Platform
projectItems.description: A learning management system that allows students, teachers, center staff, and QC teams to create, manage, complete, and grade learning activities and exam practice tasks. Developed fullstack features for assignment creation, student submissions, teacher grading, QC workflows, learning progress management, and test simulation flows. Technology: NextJS, Shadcn/ui, NestJS. Team: 3 members.
